title: EventEnvelope
description: Single append-only EventStore record. Sole runtime authority; all other JSON (state, tree, manifest) is a rebuildable projection. See ../event_store.md.

sequence.description: Monotonic per-run sequence; CommandHandler appends via expected-sequence CAS.

actor.description: role/session_id that produced the underlying command, null for kernel-internal events.

payload.description: Shape discriminated by sibling `type`; each event type's payload schema is defined per-type in ../event_store.md §2 and is intentionally not inlined here (would require one $defs entry per enum value in `type`). Deliberate exception to the family-wide additionalProperties:false convention.

causation_id.description: event_id of the event this one is a direct reaction to.

correlation_id.description: Groups events belonging to the same command/tick round-trip.
